base_probability.concentration: one shared positive concentration fitted by outer-training Dirichlet-multinomial maximum likelihood
base_probability.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize_scalar bounded on log concentration from log(0.001) through log(1000000); boundary solutions fail
base_probability.catboost_baseline: log posterior probability for all eight classes

residual_model.parameter_selection: none; inherited once from the frozen all-prior CatBoost core comparator

explicitly_excluded_features: history outcome counts and rates already consumed by the EB offset
target-game actual lineup slot or any unreceipted projected lineup
all postgame and same-day outcome fields

chronological_evaluation.algorithm: deterministic expanding split over sorted unique 2023 dates matching sklearn TimeSeriesSplit default boundaries

pa_opportunity.support: observed positive integer PA counts only
pa_opportunity.reason: The delivered historical lineup slot is sourced from the completed-game feed and lacks a pregame receipt. It may define outcome identity but cannot be consumed as a point-in-time predictor.
pa_opportunity.future_market_use: A later prospective runner may condition opportunity only on a receipt-proven projected or confirmed pregame lineup under the separately locked opportunity contract.

comparators: row-wise strict-prior empirical-Bayes player posterior with fitted concentration
row-wise strict-prior empirical-Bayes player posterior with frozen 200-PA concentration
frozen all-prior CatBoost core family refitted only on each outer-training fold using the repaired panel

market_components.reason: Historical target-game lineup availability is not receipt-proven. Final market qualification therefore requires untouched prospective predictions with valid lineup evidence.

gates.proper_score_materiality: For Brier and log loss separately, candidate-minus-each comparator point estimate and date-block 95% upper bound must be below negative one percent of that comparator score for every required component.
gates.discrimination: Candidate AUC must be defined and no lower than every comparator in aggregate and every outer fold for every required component.
gates.calibration: Candidate absolute bias and prediction-decile ECE must be no worse than every comparator for every required component.
gates.hr_high_probability_tail: On the candidate prediction-defined top decile, support must be at least 500 player-games and 20 home runs; candidate absolute calibration gap must be no worse than every comparator, and candidate-minus-comparator Brier and log-loss point estimates plus date-block 95% upper bounds must be no greater than zero.
gates.chronology_identity_fallback: All chronology, identity, probability, support, missingness, and no-fallback boundaries must pass.
gates.development_only: A 2023 survivor is not a promotion and must be frozen before a new untouched future confirmation window begins.
